subjects.white-tailed-deer: Adult male white-tailed deer; natural muted brown-grey autumn coat; white underside of flag tail and throat; slender legs; small dark eyes; branching antlers.
subjects.moose: Adult bull moose, Alces alces; broad palmate antlers; dark brown shaggy coat; pale lower legs; high shoulder hump; long overhanging muzzle; large ears; hanging dewlap; short tail.
subjects.black-bear: Adult American black bear; black to dark brown coarse fur; brown muzzle; rounded upright ears; small dark eyes; powerful broad paws; rounded rump and shoulders without grizzly hump.
subjects.beaver: Adult North American beaver, Castor canadensis; compact low brown fur body; small rounded ears and eyes; blunt muzzle; short forelegs; large hind feet; long flat dark leathery scaled paddle tail.
subjects.eastern-wolf: Adult eastern wolf, Canis lycaon; slender long-legged build; narrow muzzle; upright ears; medium bushy tail held down; grizzled grey and muted rusty brown coat; darker saddle; pale lower face and belly; small natural amber eyes.
